subcategory_text: Develop a plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities on all enterprise assets and remediate them based on risk.
implementation_examples: IG1: Run automated vulnerability scans; remediate critical vulns
IG2: Subscribe to threat intel; integrate scanning in CI/CD
IG3: Run authenticated scans; perform penetration testing
assessment_objectives: Determine whether vulnerability scans run on a cadence.
Determine whether vulns are remediated within SLA.
